text:
samira.t: Hi team, day 3 and hitting my first blocker. I accepted the org invite and the UI shows me as a Member, but I don't have access to any team repos (404 on clone and 'You don’t have permission' in the web UI). I did Okta SSO and 2FA. Any ideas?

infra-team: Welcome @samira.t :wave: Two quick questions — does your org profile list any teams under your membership, and can you run `gh api /user` and `gh api /orgs/redwood-inference/memberships/$(gh api /user --jq .login)` to check the membership state?

samira.t: Org profile shows me as Member but Teams section in the org profile is empty. `gh api /user --jq .login` -> "samira-t". Membership API returns "active" but `gh api orgs/redwood-inference/teams --jq '.[] | select(.slug=="platform")'` returns nothing for me.

josh.dev: If GH lists you as Member but teams aren't assigned, could be SCIM/group-sync delay from Okta or team mapping not applied. Sometimes SCIM returns after a few minutes. Did you get a separate email about accepting SAML provisioning?

samira.t: I got only the org invite email, not a separate provisioning email. I authorized SAML when prompted on the org page.

infra-team: Ok. Two likely causes: 1) SCIM provisioning queued (wait ~10 mins and re-check), or 2) the HR -> Okta group mapping didn't include the team it should. @elaine.hr can you confirm the new-hire was placed in the correct Okta group?

elaine.hr: Checking the onboarding record. HR set the new-hire to group "eng-newhires" which should map to org team "eng-onboard". Looks like the Okta mapping for "eng-newhires" -> SCIM team slug "eng-onboard" was missing for this cohort. I'll fix it and trigger a sync.

josh.dev: Good call. Infra can also force a SCIM sync from the identity provider side. After sync, teams should show up and repo perms will follow.

infra-team: Kicked off an IdP->SCIM sync for the eng-newhires group. Give it 5-15 minutes then run `gh api orgs/redwood-inference/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | select(.name=="eng-onboard")'` to verify you're a member. If still empty, try `gh auth refresh` and clear cookies.

samira.t: Thanks. One more odd thing: when I tried to accept a sample repo invite earlier, GitHub warned "your organization requires 2FA" and blocked acceptance until I added a security key, even though I already have TOTP enabled. Could that be related?

infra-team: That's separate: org can require specific 2FA methods (we require 2FA but not security keys). If GitHub showed a security-key requirement, that was probably a temporary policy mismatch between org and the invite (sometimes policy updates propagate oddly). We can check the org's 2FA enforcement setting. For now TOTP is acceptable.

elaine.hr: I updated the Okta mapping and flagged the IdP group for immediate sync. Also filed a request with infra to double-check org 2FA enforcement settings in case a recent policy change caused the security-key prompt.

onboard-bot: Ticket #4810 created: "scim team mapping missing for eng-newhires -> causes member without teams" assigned to infra-admins. ETA: 4 hours.

samira.t: Sync finished and I can see the eng-onboard team now. Ran `gh repo list redwood-inference --private` and can see the expected repos. Cloned infra/ops and opened my first PR. Thanks everyone! :tada:

josh.dev: Welcome aboard! If anything else odd pops up, DM me and I’ll take a look at team membership and Okta logs.

onboard-bot: Ticket #4810 -> infra-admins. Status: resolved by IdP sync.
